title: Update references in README to SCM 8.0.1
Update to Scientific Colour Maps version 8
description:
This bumps the source version for Scientific Colour Maps to the just released version 8 (zenodo source link: https://zenodo.org/record/8035877). This was, essentially, just updating the source URLs and expanding some details in the DESCRIPTION 

I ran through the typical checks and included tests plus confirmed the new palettes were present with `scico_palette_names()` and `scico_palette_show()`. I also confirmed that those with categorical were properly parsed and available.

title: deal with issues 2 and 3
description:
Howdy!  I've been using this package quite a bit, and kept coming across the discrete scale issue (issue #2), so I thought I'd take a whack at it.  I basically just did the same thing as `scale_color/fill_viridis_d` that's already part of ggplot.  Not sure if that's the route you'd want to take, but it appears to work just fine.  While I was at it, I figured I'd add the new palettes as well (issue #3).  Some things to note:

- new functions `scale_colour_scico_d/scale_color_scico_d/scale_fill_scico_d`
- added acton, bamako etc. to `palettes.rda`
- build passes R CMD check with 0 errors 0 warnings 0 messages
- added `testthat` tests for both color and fill discrete
- checked new code against `goodpractice::gp()`
- checked that `scico_palette_data/_show` work with new palettes
- did not update DESCRIPTION beyond the need to pass R CMD CHECK (e.g. still says 17 palettes)
- used the new batlow (scientific rainbow) palette for the default discrete palette
- added example to the `ggplot2-scales` man page for the discrete case

This is my first stab at a fork and pull for something that wasn't a project I was involved with from the beginning, so if there is anything in particular you need done differently just let me know and I can try and work it out.  Thanks again for offering this, and all of your other useful packages.  Hopefully this saves you a little effort.

title: Add new palettes bam, bamO, batlowK, batlowW, bukavu, fes, vanimo
description:
According to #10 this PR adds the new color palettes available from Fabio http://www.fabiocrameri.ch/cycliccolourmaps.php: 

* bam
* bamO
* batlowK
* batlowW
* bukavu
* fes 
* vanimo

title: Add circular palettes brocO, corkO, and vikO
description:
I noticed that Fabio Crameri also created three cyclic color palettes that are specifically for depicting circular data: <http://www.fabiocrameri.ch/cycliccolourmaps.php>

If you'd like to have these in the `scico` package, this PR adds them: brocO, corkO, and vikO.
